intro: Explore spectral measurements of historical pigments recorded with various instruments.
footer: Data and metadata provided for research and teaching purposes.

pigments.name: Azurite
pigments.title: Azurite
pigments.description: Azurite is a natural blue copper carbonate mineral historically used as a pigment. Use the controls to compare spectra acquired with different binders and instruments.

pigments.name: Chrysocolla
pigments.title: Chrysocolla
pigments.description: Chrysocolla is a hydrated copper silicate mineral historically used as a pigment. Use the controls to compare spectra acquired with different binders and instruments.

instruments.FORS: FORS (Fiber Optic Reflectance Spectroscopy) provides reflectance vs wavelength in the visible/near-infrared range.
instruments.FT-IR: FT-IR (Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy) measures absorption in the mid-infrared (wavenumber) region.
instruments.Raman: Raman spectroscopy provides vibrational spectra useful for identifying molecular species.
